name: The Root Court
reading: Peak Pond Hollow is the garden town where Erika keeps the peace between the residents and the arrivals (docs/world-building/TOWN_CHARACTER.md gym4_town; moss, packed mud, mud brick, cherry, the garden's plants). The Great Glasshouse above is the gardeners' own house and her walled court is its north end. Under that court is where she hears them: a mediation court dug into the roots of the great cherry. It is a RING, not a hall: a round floor of mud brick, ringed by a low bar and four tiers of cherry benches rising round it, one side for each party, with roots standing in the tiers and coming through the vault, glow-berry vines and shroomlights hanging in it, and azalea planted along the outer bench. Both parties come in the same way, down the court's own stair wound round a post of cherry and along one aisle cut through the benches, and stand behind a ring of plank inlaid in the floor; a round of moss at its middle, between the two Pokemon marks, is the common ground. Erika is not in the ring. She sits on a raised bench of cherry at the far side, four courses over the floor, under a great root of the tree that has come down through the vault behind her: the place of the one who hears both.

battle.why: Cobblemon Battle Positions (docs/world-building/GYM_ARENAS.md): both Pokemon blocks sit one under the floor's top course so spawnHeightOffset 2.0 stands each Pokemon ON the floor; the trainer stand is under the bench's top one in front of the seat, so Erika steps to the bench's front edge. Her team's widest sweep is Victreebel's, 5.28 (data/gym_arena_sizes.json): her Pokemon is 6.5 from the bench face (z1512 against the mark's centre at z1505.5), so the nearest solid at floor height is 1.22 outside the sweep, and the challenger's is 6.36 from the bar at the aisle's mouth (1.08 outside). The two marks are 5 apart (Tangrowth's hitbox is 1.8 wide; Victreebel's sweep is the number that sizes the ring). The challenger stands 3 behind their own, as the donor gyms set it. All four blocks are found from all 162 cells a battle can start from (the floor from z1499 to z1508: nearer the bench her own bench blocks the line).

blocks_why: the town's own palette (TOWN_CHARACTER.md gym4_town: moss, packed mud, mud brick, cherry, azalea, the garden's plants) plus the roots of the tree.
